context: Redesign change 7 (:93) and the 09:20Z dispatch-naming answer: dispatches are named by RCF stage. The 0.36.1 guidance still has the verifier run rcf verify run against the preview or version host at Test, Finalise write verified from the Test-stage report, and hands as a process concept (audit F-12, F-13, F-44 to F-47). Consumers carry the managed block in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md; rcf doctor reports a block that differs from the shipped one as stale.
decision: Every shipped text is rewritten to TAC TAC-4159: stage sections named by prefix and role, TEST against a locally running app with nothing deployed, Finalise light and pre-merge writing complete, Verify outside the cycle writing verified, the rounds rule, and the bundle runbook naming each stage's dispatch "<Stage> <fbs-id>: <title>". "Role" names who does a stage's work; "hand" disappears as a process concept and the Hand: trailer appears only in the transition note. The managed block's hash and harness fragment are regenerated by scripts/gen-managed-artefacts.mjs (a declared generator). The 0.37.0 feed entry carries minAgentAction rerun-init, the validator's value for a managed-block refresh, so rcf version --check and the release notes tell every consumer to rerun rcf init and run rcf doctor.
consequences: Every consumer gets the new block on rcf init; stale blocks show in rcf doctor. The bundle goldens and the guidance stage-contract tests move (part B and the round's DEFINE re-record them). The HQ upgrade (rollout step 2) follows the release.

alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Consumers would keep the 0.36.x block that tells their agents to verify inside the cycle.

title: Guidance and the managed block are rewritten to the 0.37.0 model, dispatches are named by stage, and the release asks agents to rerun init
